trial.signupTitle: Try Godwit free for one month
trial.signupBody: New accounts creating their first Godwit workspace receive unlimited Eggs and up to 10 customer Egg sessions over 30 days, whichever comes first. No card is required and you will not be charged automatically. The trial starts when Godwit creates your workspace after you confirm your email, usually on your first dashboard visit. At the limit, new Egg sessions pause. Paid-plan checkout is not yet available.

donationCard.disclaimer: Payments are securely processed by Stripe. The venue selected this category: {{category}}. The venue is responsible for the legal classification, receipt, refunds, and any tax treatment. Godwit is the technology platform and keeps a 9% platform fee; 91% goes to the venue. This payment is not automatically tax-deductible. Godwit never sees or stores your card details.

benefits.intro: These are two separate customer choices. An email benefit is for people who consent to follow-up; a public review is optional feedback for everyone. Do not exchange a benefit for a positive rating.
benefits.title: Two separate ways to build loyalty
benefits.emailBody: You can send the updates or offers you described when asking for consent, and download the consented list with timestamps. This is private follow-up and never depends on a positive vote.
benefits.reviewTitle: When someone leaves a Google or other public review
benefits.reviewBody: You build public trust through an honest review on the selected platform. Show the same review links to everyone and never ask for a positive rating or gate a benefit by sentiment.

quickStart.title: One goal. A helpful experience.
quickStart.intro: Choose what matters to your business. We'll show you where to start.
quickStart.businessTitle: What kind of business or place is this Egg for?
quickStart.goalTitle: What should Godwit help your customers do?
quickStart.chooseHint: Choose a goal to see your next steps.
quickStart.shareStep: Add your content to an Egg, test it, then share its QR code or NFC link.
quickStart.benefitNote: A small thank-you can reward private feedback or an email opt-in. Never offer a benefit for a public review.
quickStart.planAvailability: This feature's availability depends on your workspace plan.
quickStart.continueHint: Sign in if needed. You'll set up the tools in your workspace.
quickStart.existingEggHint: Open your Egg from the Eggs section to preview and share it.

help-and-guide.title: Answer questions and guide customers
help-and-guide.example: Use trusted business information to answer questions and point customers to useful next steps, such as booking or ordering.
help-and-guide.setup: Create an Egg, add your website or FAQs, enable the assistant, and include relevant booking, ordering, or contact links.
help-and-guide.result: Test common customer questions and review Egg visits and the actions you make available.

answers.title: Answer customer questions
answers.example: Track Egg visits while customers get answers from your business information.
answers.setup: Create an Egg, open its AI assistant, add your website or FAQs, then enable Godwit.
answers.result: Test a customer question before sharing. Godwit answers from your sources and suggests relevant content.

feedback.title: Collect feedback responses
feedback.example: Track poll responses over time and see what customers think about their experience.
feedback.setup: Open or create an Egg, then add a short feedback poll to its experience.
feedback.result: Open your poll's results to see answers and spot what could improve.

information.title: Show menus, stories & details
information.example: Track Egg visits as you share menus, event listings, stories, or practical details.
information.setup: Create an Egg and add an information card with your text, image, and useful links.
information.result: Customers find your content without an account. Update it whenever details change.

next-step.title: Guide customers to a next step
next-step.example: Track Egg visits while linking customers to booking, ordering, product, or contact options.
next-step.setup: Add a contact or booking link to an information card on an Egg.
next-step.result: Enquiries reach you through your linked email or booking page, not a new Godwit inbox.

contacts.title: Collect opted-in contacts
contacts.example: Track consented email sign-ups from customers who choose to hear from you.
contacts.setup: Open or create an Egg, add a poll, and configure a clear email opt-in under After voting.
contacts.result: Export consented contacts from Customer connection. People can vote without sharing their email.

reviews.title: Invite honest reviews
reviews.example: Track Egg visits while offering the same optional review links to every customer.
reviews.setup: Add your review-site links in Settings, then include them when setting up an Egg.
reviews.result: Offer the same review links to everyone. Public reviews are optional and never tied to a reward.

preferences.title: Find out what visitors want
preferences.example: Ask a short, neutral poll about what visitors are interested in and review their answers.
preferences.setup: Add a simple poll to the Egg and ask one clear question about visitor preferences.
preferences.result: Use poll results to see what visitors chose. Answers are anonymous unless people separately opt in to share contact details.

satisfaction.title: Measure customer satisfaction
satisfaction.example: Ask visitors how satisfied they are and track the responses over time.
satisfaction.setup: Add a neutral satisfaction poll with clear answer choices to the Egg.
satisfaction.result: Review poll responses and trends. Godwit reports the answers collected; it does not infer a rating that customers did not provide.

issue-reporting.title: Report an issue while on site
issue-reporting.example: Let visitors send a categorized report when something at the venue needs attention.
issue-reporting.setup: Issue reporting is available from the visitor Egg. Configure in-app, email, or SMS alerts in Settings.
issue-reporting.result: Review reports in the Settings inbox and receive alerts through the channels you enable.

promotion.title: Promote an event, product, or special offer
promotion.example: Describe what you want to promote, then share those details through the Egg.
promotion.setup: Enter the event, product, or offer details when creating the Egg, then add clear information and a relevant link.
promotion.result: Visitors can see the details from the Egg. Keep dates, prices, terms, and availability up to date.

event-interest.title: Collect event registrations or interest
event-interest.example: Use a poll to gauge interest. This does not create a named attendee list or reserve a place.
event-interest.setup: Add an event-interest poll and include the event details in an information card. A named RSVP list is not currently supported.
event-interest.result: Review poll responses to measure interest. Do not treat them as confirmed registrations.

return-visits.title: Bring customers back
return-visits.example: Invite customers to return with relevant information and consent-based email follow-up.
return-visits.setup: Add a clear opt-in for email follow-up, then configure a win-back message for consenting contacts.
return-visits.result: Review consented contacts and follow-up activity. Only people who explicitly opt in receive marketing email.

landing.eyebrow: A goal-directed AI agent for customer engagement
landing.title: Make every customer interaction more helpful.
landing.lede: Give Godwit a goal and trusted business information. Its AI helps answer questions, collect feedback, and guide customers to useful next steps through an Egg shared by QR or NFC. You stay in control; outcomes depend on your customers.
landing.note: For cafes, pubs, restaurants, hotels, artists, galleries, museums, destinations, events, shops, and local services.

eggFeatures.title: Meet Godwit through an Egg.
eggFeatures.lede: Godwit is your goal-directed AI agent. An Egg is its reusable customer access point. Place it where people need help and update it without replacing the QR code or NFC tag.
eggFeatures.accessDetail: Show a QR code, add an NFC tag, or offer both. Each opens the same up-to-date Egg.
eggFeatures.assistantTitle: Goal-led AI grounded in your business
eggFeatures.assistantDetail: Add your website or FAQs so Godwit can answer customer questions and guide them toward the goals and actions you choose.
eggFeatures.guidanceDetail: Connect questions to the relevant feedback poll, information card, booking link, or other action you provide.
eggFeatures.control: You choose the goals, business information, and whether AI is enabled. Godwit supports your work without guaranteeing business outcomes.

landing.howItWorksTitle: Set a goal. Let Godwit guide each customer interaction.

steps.step1Title: Choose the outcome you want to support
steps.step1Detail: Answer questions, share browsable details, collect private feedback, or guide customers to bookings and enquiries.
steps.step1DetailWithDonations: Answer questions, share browsable details, collect private feedback, or guide customers to bookings and enquiries.
steps.step2Detail: Use your website or add FAQs so Godwit can answer questions using information you provide.
steps.step3Detail: Customers scan or tap to get answers, browse information, share feedback, or follow a useful action you provide.

landing.outcomesTitle: Useful for your customers. Actionable for your business.

outcomes.conversionDetail: Ground answers in your information and connect customers to the actions you choose.
outcomes.growthDetail: Use short polls and customer responses to learn what is working and what could improve.
outcomes.publicDetail: Invite customers to opt in to private follow-up. Keep any benefit separate from public reviews.
outcomes.donationsDetail: The same Egg can also offer voluntary venue support, processed securely through Stripe.

landing.useCasesEyebrow: One assistant, many kinds of places
landing.useCasesTitle: Made for the places people visit.
landing.useCasesLede: Set a customer-engagement goal. Godwit uses your information to guide interactions, while you choose the actions and stay in control.

useCases.artsDetail: Artists, galleries, and museums can share stories, answer questions, and invite feedback or enquiries.
useCases.hospitalityDetail: Cafes, pubs, restaurants, and hotels can share menus and event details, answer guest questions, link to bookings, and collect private feedback.
useCases.placesDetail: Destinations and city teams can share local knowledge and help visitors discover what to do next.
useCases.eventsDetail: Event teams and community groups can share updates, gather feedback, and make it easy to get involved.
useCases.shopsDetail: Local businesses can explain what they offer, answer product questions, and hear from customers.

landing.flockCardAriaLabel: Go to {{name}}'s area of the dashboard

flock.robinDetail: Walks brand-new workspaces through their first poll, first Egg, and first vote — no manual required.
flock.redshankDetail: Routes low-score feedback to a private message before it ever reaches Google, Booking, or Tripadvisor.
flock.eggRole: One touchpoint, many ways to connect
flock.eggDetail: Bring polls, information, and tasks together in one reusable destination, opened by QR code or NFC tag.
flock.eggDetailWithDonations: Bring polls, information, tasks, and venue support together in one reusable destination, opened by QR code or NFC tag.
flock.flamingoDetail: Shows off your strongest feedback in a polished, public-facing display guests actually enjoy reading.
flock.ternDetail: One scan, one question, one honest answer — surveys light enough for a busy counter or doorway.
flock.waxwingDetail: Pulls trends from every poll and Egg into one dashboard, plus redemption tracking and automated nurture emails for workspaces ready to grow faster.
flock.waxwingDetailWithDonations: Pulls trends from every poll and Egg into one dashboard, plus redemption tracking, venue support, and automated nurture emails for workspaces ready to grow faster.
flock.owlDetail: Keeps an eye on your brand, your team's access, and your plan, quietly, until something needs your attention.

landing.finalTitle: Give Godwit a goal to support.
landing.finalCopy: Choose what matters, provide trusted information, and let Godwit help customers take a useful next step through an Egg.

interactions.returned: Returned from checkout. Your allowance updates only after payment confirmation. Refresh billing to check its status.
interactions.planChanges: Monthly subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in the billing portal. Upgrades are prorated and take effect immediately without resetting used interactions. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.
interactions.countingBody: The first customer Egg open per browser session across an account’s Eggs counts as one interaction. Repeat opens in that session and staff previews do not count. All plans include unlimited Eggs.
interactions.trialInfo: The free trial includes 10 interactions for 30 days. It does not automatically start a paid subscription. Choose a monthly plan to continue when the trial expires or runs out.
interactions.topupBody: One payment of €7 for 100 extra interactions, valid for 30 days after purchase. Not recurring; unused top-up interactions expire. Top-ups are used after the monthly base allowance.
interactions.topupEligibility: Buying and using top-ups requires an active paid subscription, including when its interaction allowance is exhausted. Not available for the free trial. This link opens billing; purchase requires a separate checkout action.
interactions.refunds: For billing questions or refund requests, contact support. Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.

interactions.trialWarning: Your free trial allowance is nearly used up. Choose a paid monthly plan to keep your Eggs available.

interactions.legacy: This workspace uses a legacy plan. Interaction usage is not available for this plan; review billing before changing it.

useCases.small: For street artists, independent creators and small pop-ups: share your story, collect feedback or offer a contact link.
useCases.standard: For cafes, pubs, shops and local services: answer common questions, collect reviews and invite email opt-ins.

proposed.countingTitle: How is the free trial counted?
proposed.countingBody: Trial counting is enforced: one first customer Egg open per browser session across a workspace's Eggs counts toward its 10-interaction allowance. Repeat opens in the same session and staff previews don't count. Paid-package counting and checkout are still proposals.
proposed.topUpsBody: Optional top-up packs are planned. Pack sizes, prices, and the purchase flow have not been set.
proposed.statusNote: Existing plan features and limits remain in effect. Paid-package pricing and counting, top-ups, and Stripe checkout will need a separate implementation before this proposal can be purchased.

businessGuidance.hospitality: For cafes, pubs, restaurants, and hotels: share menus or events, answer guest questions, collect feedback, or link to bookings.
businessGuidance.places: For destinations, attractions, and city teams: share directions or local information, answer visitor questions, collect feedback, or link to activities.
businessGuidance.events: For events and communities: share schedules or updates, answer attendee questions, collect feedback, or make it easier to take part.
businessGuidance.shops: For shops and local services: explain products or services, answer common questions, collect feedback, or link to bookings and enquiries.

businessGuidance.restaurant-food: For restaurants and food venues: share menus and dietary information, answer guest questions, collect feedback, or link to ordering and reservations.
businessGuidance.accommodation: For accommodation: share guest information, amenities, accessibility, local tips, and booking or contact links.
businessGuidance.arts-culture: For arts, culture, and museums: share exhibition details and stories, answer visitor questions, collect feedback, or invite enquiries.
businessGuidance.visitor-attraction: For attractions and destinations: share directions, opening times, ticket details, accessibility, and practical local information.
businessGuidance.event-venue: For events and venues: share schedules, entry details, facilities, and ways to participate; gather attendee feedback.
businessGuidance.retail-market: For shops and markets: explain products using supplied information, answer common questions, collect feedback, or link to purchase.
businessGuidance.local-service: For local services: explain services, appointment preparation, accessibility, and existing booking or enquiry options.
businessGuidance.community-space: For community and public spaces: share services, programs, opening times, accessibility, and ways to take part.

card.setOneUp: Create one in the Eggs tab

card.untrackedQrNote: This is a quick, untracked QR link for this poll only. For a reusable, trackable Egg—with QR, NFC, or both—or one that bundles this poll with information and other options, create it in the
card.previewNote: The preview changes immediately and is used when you print.
card.modifyQrHint: Add a message and choose a ready-made background before downloading or printing.

connection.title: Turn one QR scan into an ongoing relationship.
connection.subtitle: Use this page as your checklist. Ask for an email only with clear consent, invite selected voters to leave honest public feedback, and release benefits according to your configured rules.

step1.title: Configure the offer in the poll
step1.body: The offer shown after voting is configured when you create or edit the poll. You can give an opted-in voter a voucher or discount after they share their email and consent to follow-up.

step2.title: Collect permission
step2.body: Voters can voluntarily share their email after voting. Use the email settings below to send event news, offers, or a follow-up message.

step3.title: Set up public review destinations
step3.body: Save your Google, Tripadvisor, or other review-page links in Settings. Add selected links to an Egg so every visitor can leave honest feedback. Never gate these links by sentiment.

whatCustomerSees.title: What the customer sees
whatCustomerSees.voteBody: They open the Egg by QR or NFC and answer without creating an account.
whatCustomerSees.stayConnectedBody: They choose whether to share an email for follow-up and benefits.
whatCustomerSees.shareHonestlyBody: Every voter, whatever they answered, receives your review links and can submit a verification claim.
whatCustomerSees.disclaimer: Do not require or script a positive review. Benefits should be offered transparently and review requests should invite honest feedback.

emailList.title: Consented email list
emailList.description: Download only the email addresses people voluntarily shared after choosing follow-up. Anonymous voters are never included.
emailList.legalNote: Use this list only for the purpose you explained when collecting consent. Check your privacy notice, retention policy, and applicable GDPR/local rules before importing or contacting anyone.
emailList.lockedDescription: Export the people who explicitly opted in to follow-up, with their consent timestamp.

benefits.title: Keep the two benefits separate
benefits.intro: An email benefit is offered only to voters who share their email and consent to follow-up. A public review is optional feedback for everyone. Never exchange a reward for a positive rating.
benefits.emailBody: Configure this in Create or Edit Poll under After voting. Choose a voucher or discount code, then show it only after the voter opts in with a clear consent purpose.
benefits.reviewTitle: Public review on Google, Tripadvisor, or another site
benefits.reviewBody: Save the review-page location in Settings, then select the destination when building an Egg. Show the same review option to everyone and invite honest feedback, positive or negative.

connection.emailDeliveryNote: Automatic delivery uses Resend, an email-sending service. Your server needs RESEND_API_KEY (the private Resend credential) and REPORT_FROM_EMAIL (a verified sender address), configured in the deployment settings. This is the same setup used for weekly reports.

emailAutomations.description: Two independent, opt-in email automations - set up either, both, or neither. Both only ever reach voters who explicitly left their email and consented; voting itself always stays anonymous.

leadNurture.title: Lead nurture emails
leadNurture.description: Automatically email voters who opted in for follow-up (or a prize draw) right after they vote.
leadNurture.subjectPlaceholder: Email subject: Thanks for your feedback!
leadNurture.lockedDescription: You're collecting emails already - turn them into repeat visits with an automatic thank-you email, no manual work required.

winback.title: Win-back emails
winback.description: Automatically email a voter who left their email and consented, but hasn't voted again after the number of days below. This only reaches people who opted in - voting itself always stays anonymous.
winback.lockedTitle: Win back customers who've gone quiet
winback.lockedDescription: Automatically re-engage voters who haven't come back in a while, without manually tracking who's overdue.

intro.eyebrow: How polls and Eggs fit together
intro.title: One Egg, many ways to connect.
intro.body: Polls (in the Polls tab) are your questions. An Egg is the reusable experience you share with customers. It can include one or more polls, information cards, tasks, and an optional AI assistant. Customers open the same Egg with a QR code, NFC tag, or both. Build and update Eggs here; each poll's card shows which Eggs it's linked to.

scanner.title: Recognize your Egg
scanner.subtitle: Paste the Egg link, scan its QR code, or read its NFC tag to recognize it and update the experience.
scanner.pastePlaceholder: Paste the Egg's QR or NFC link
scanner.holdNfc: Hold the NFC tag near your phone to recognize the Egg.
scanner.nfcUnsupported: Direct NFC reading needs a compatible phone and browser over HTTPS (such as Chrome on Android). Otherwise, tap the tag with your phone, copy the opened Egg link, and paste it above.
scanner.nfcError: Could not read the NFC link. Check NFC and browser permissions, try again, or paste the Egg link.
scanner.lookupError: Could not recognize this Egg. Please try again.
scanner.invalidLink: Paste a valid Egg link or scan its QR code or NFC tag.
scanner.notFound: No Egg with this link was found in your account.
scanner.redirectLabel: Change the poll on this Egg
scanner.createNewPoll: Create a new poll for this Egg

donations.title: Venue support payments
donations.notEnabled: Venue-support payments are not enabled yet. Stripe setup and new payment registrations are temporarily unavailable.
donations.description: Let visitors support your venue with a card or wallet payment from an Egg. Connect a Stripe account once here, then add a "Venue support" item to an Egg. Stripe processes the payment: 91% transfers straight to your account and Godwit keeps a 9% platform fee. This is not a charitable donation or a tax-deductible payment.
donations.stripeConnected: Stripe is connected and ready to accept venue-support payments.
donations.stripeStarted: Stripe account started, but onboarding isn't finished yet.
donations.beforeYouConnect: You'll need: your bank account details (IBAN) and a form of ID. Takes about 3-5 minutes, on Stripe's own secure page.
donations.messagePlaceholder: Optional message shown with the support-payment option
donations.feeNote: Stripe processes the payment. This is a voluntary payment to the venue, not a charitable donation and not tax-deductible. Godwit never sees or stores card details. Of each payment, 9% is a Godwit platform fee and 91% transfers to your connected Stripe account.
donations.categoryHelp: Select the wording that best matches your legal and commercial situation. Godwit does not determine the legal classification.
donations.categoryDisclaimer: For commercial venues and artists, Tip or Voluntary contribution is usually safer wording. Use Charitable donation only after confirming the recipient's legal status, receipt rules, and tax treatment with an adviser.

campaigns.title: Eggs
campaigns.description: Create one reusable customer destination. Add polls, useful information, rewards, or tasks, then let customers open the same Egg by QR code or NFC tag.
campaigns.tip: QR and NFC open the same Egg. Update its experience here without replacing the printed code or rewriting the tag. Add the optional AI assistant to answer questions from your business information and guide customers to relevant polls, information, or tasks.
campaigns.noCampaigns: No Eggs yet. Create your first one above.
campaigns.shareHint: Preview the customer experience or prepare your QR and NFC access.
campaigns.nfcInstruction: Write the NFC link to a compatible tag. Keep the Egg's QR code nearby as a fallback.

campaigns.sessionRequired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to view Egg access analytics.
campaigns.loadFailed: Egg access analytics couldn't be loaded. Refresh the dashboard and try again. If it continues, contact support.
campaigns.nameRequired: Enter a name for this Egg.
campaigns.printScale: Print at 100% / actual size. Turn off browser headers and footers. Dimensions include the QR's white quiet zone.
campaigns.simplePrintHint: A large QR, a simple Egg frame and a clear Godwit logo. The preview matches your download and print.
campaigns.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups to open the print preview.

campaigns.itemsHint: Add polls, information cards, rewards, and tasks to this Egg. Customers can scan its QR code or tap its NFC tag to open the same experience.
campaigns.advancedDescription: Track rewards configured after voting or run prize draws — all optional and managed as part of customer connection. Donations are set up in Settings.

ai.sharedData: Uses your shared Business Data, plus any information added here.
ai.title: AI business assistant
ai.description: Answer customer questions using your website or FAQs, then suggest a relevant poll, information card, or open task. The assistant admits when it doesn't know; customers can still contact you directly.
ai.enable: Show the AI assistant on this Egg
ai.addMaterialFirst: Add at least one business information source before enabling the assistant.
ai.usageLimits: Usage is capped: 5 messages per visitor session, 100 per Egg each day, and 1,000 per workspace each month.

ai.keepTopic: Keep at least one feedback topic selected.
ai.websiteHint: We import readable text from your public website. Review the source list and add important details manually if anything is missing.
ai.signInRequired: Sign in to manage this Egg.

items.enableDonationsNote: Set up and enable venue support in Settings to add this payment option to the Egg.

redemptions.lockedTitle: See how often rewards are actually redeemed

sentiment.title: Answer sentiment (AI)

updates.title: "We heard you" updates
updates.subtitle: Post a public update when you act on feedback (e.g., "We fixed the slow Wi-Fi you mentioned"). It shows on the poll's public results page.

recovery.title: Feedback recovery and weekly reports
recovery.openAlertsHint: Open alerts, including low-score/answer matches and automatic vote-volume drop warnings (checked daily).

recovery.lockedDescription: A Monday email with votes, open alerts, and recovery tasks - so you don't have to log in to stay on top of things.
